metadata.source: OWASP Testing Guide, OWASP CORS Cheat Sheet

description: CORS misconfig allows attacker to read cross-origin responses, leading to data theft.

testing: Test with Origin: https://evil.com, check if Access-Control-Allow-Origin returns evil.com and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials true
methodology.evidence: Request with Origin evil.com returns ACAO evil.com and ACAC true, tool output
methodology.verification: Reproduce with evil origin, confirm misconfig

remediation: Validate Origin via allow list, not *, no credentials with *
